title: National Crime Surveys:  Index of Crime Severity, 1977
description:
The purpose of this data collection was to determine the 
 seriousness of criminal events. The principal investigators sought to 
 determine and rate the relative seriousness of murder, rape, and petty 
 theft. Information in the collection includes respondents' opinions on 
 the severity of particular crimes as well as how that severity compared 
to other crimes.
